knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Model answer from source: Identify task-specific unknown hazards, qualifications, permissions and controls; place work on hold until verified.
Model answer from source: No. Relevant licences, employer/site authorisation and independent competence verification remain required.

The lesson says some work that looks like cleaning is in fact regulated work, and that starting it without the right licence, permit or authorisation exposes the worker, the client and the business to risk.

practicalCriteria: type: supervised tabletop simulation; task: Write a restricted-work referral decision that does not authorise work.; deliverable: Record the boundary between permissible cleaning and restricted work.; criteria: Specific work and exclusions correctly identified; Unknown hazards and regulated boundaries escalated; Controls and approver recorded; Customer communication contains no unsupported assurance
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record the boundary between permissible cleaning and restricted work.
Signed task scope, controls and excluded activities
Reviewer identity, role, date, evidence references and location
stopWorkCriteria: Performs work without required site or legal authorisation
Treats unidentified hazards or regulated activities as routine cleaning
